subject: POC results & quick permission to use a two-line blurb + 15m sync
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sasha Nguyen <sasha@velocityai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: POC results & quick permission to use a two-line blurb + 15m sync

Hi Sasha —

Thanks again for running the POC with us last week. Quick recap from our side (attached full summary):

- Inference latency: median 48ms (95th percentile 120ms) on your typical 512-token queries.
- Cost per 1k tokens: estimated $0.42 after batching and prefix caching (see CSV).
- Throughput: sustained 220 qps during your daytime traffic window with no dropped requests.

The pilot met the primary KPI you outlined (reduce latency by 30% vs current host) and the ops team saw consistent savings on token spend when the cache was enabled. I attached the short POC report and a token cost breakdown for your finance team.

If VelocityAI is happy with the results, would you be comfortable with two quick things that help our case-study process?

1) A two-line, attribution-friendly blurb we can publish (example below you can edit):
   "VelocityAI reduced inference latency by ~30% and cut per-request token costs by 35% after a short POC with Redwood Inference."

2) A 15-minute sync (recorded) to capture a 1-sentence quote and confirm metric language. I can run this — proposed slots: Tue 6/22 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 6/23 14:00-14:30 PT.

We only need a quick sign-off and one-liner; legal review is fine for final approval. If you'd prefer to hand the blurb to legal directly, copy them in and we'll keep it minimal.

Attached: velocity_poc_summary_v2.pdf, token_costs_breakdown.csv, dashboard_screenshot.png

Thanks — appreciate the partnership.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Sasha Nguyen <sasha@velocityai.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, VelocityAI Legal <legal@velocityai.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC results & quick permission to use a two-line blurb + 15m sync

Rachel —

Really appreciate the clear summary and the PDF. The team is pleased with the latency numbers — those P95s line up with what our infra dashboard showed. A couple of quick notes before public copy:

- Can we change "cut per-request token costs by 35%" to "reduced token spend by ~30% for the evaluated workload"? Our finance folks want the qualifier.
- For attribution, please use "VelocityAI" (no individual names) and include the narrower quote: "Redwood helped us drop P95 latency and reduced token spend for our retrieval-heavy tasks."

Legal is CC'd — they'll do a quick check but we don't expect blockers. For the 15m call, Tue 6/22 10:00 PT works for me.

Thanks — happy to help with a short quote.

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC results & quick permission to use a two-line blurb + 15m sync

Sasha —

Great to see this moving forward. Quick note from CS/ops perspective that may help the blurb phrasing: the ~30% latency improvement is representative across the two largest pipelines we tested; the cost delta is closer to 28% after we adjusted batching parameters for low-latency mode. I'm attaching the dashboard screenshot we referenced.

If you want, for the public blurb we can use this wording (aligns with your ask and our measurements):

"VelocityAI reduced P95 latency and lowered token spend for evaluation workloads after a short POC with Redwood Inference."

Rachel — I'm on the 10:00 PT call to help with any technical clarifications.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
